name: main-clock-and-setup-tests
goal: Unmodified main passes the loop-lifecycle command test on any date and the scoped-setup test matches the untagged svelte-kit sync step.

evidence: On origin/main 4a321eb6c7 (2026-11-22), bun x vitest run test/loop-lifecycle.test.ts test/self-verify-config.test.ts: 2 failed. (1) loop list --stale 10 returned stale-open and fresh-open: the command reads the wall clock while fresh-open is seeded at 2026-11-12, so it went stale on 2026-11-22. (2) 4a321eb6c7 added an untagged svelte-kit sync setup step (needed by builds:[] scenarios whose root Vitest resolves generated package tsconfigs) without updating the scoped-setup expectation. The module-tasks managed-provider wrapper failure seen at 0ea7c34e3c was already repaired by #209 (251ac770bc) and passes.

The command test pinned no clock while every workflow-level test injects now(); the scoped-setup test hardcoded the setup list and nothing tied the config change to it. Reusable change: pin Date in command-level tests that compare fixture ages.

title: Both defects live in tests, so loop record cannot pair a test-only red with a product fix; record red, repair, green and guard commands here.
